notes.title: Guncraft goes 100% free, forever on June 10th, 2025!
notes.content:
[h1][b]On June 10th, 2025, Guncraft will forever be free![/b][/h1]

It's been almost 12 years... I cannot believe it. Exato Games is no more and the team has gone off to do different things. One is working on Minecraft, another on Fortnite, two of us are making our own games, and one went into maker spaces.

But Guncraft lives on!

I keep seeing you all popping up from time to time trying to play and I wanted to help get out of your way so you could do your thing. The VPN method of LAN games is really clever. Good job on that.

There is no point in charging for Guncraft anymore, so we just won't! I hope you all are able to relive some of those great community moments together from time to time. It was a blast!

Get to hookshotting, zipping around in the copter, building fun levels, and blasting robots in the classic genre-shaping voxel shooter, one last time!

I should note that public servers will continue to be offline, but you can access the community Discord in the discussions forum to arrange multiplayer matches with fellow players using the VPN method (selecting the same VPN server and using the LAN feature).

Block and load!

[I][B]GUNCRAFT[/B][/I][B], THE EPIC VOXEL-BASED FIRST PERSON SHOOTER, AIMS ITS POWER SCOPE AT XBOX 360[/B]

[I]Loaded with New Features Including Exclusive Maps, the Console Version of the PC Sensation to Launch This Year  [/I]

[B]Twain Harte, CA – August 28, 2014 –[/B] Exato Game Studios and indie games partner GameMill Entertainment announced today that [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] will be available for digital download on the Xbox 360 games and entertainment system from Microsoft in Q4 2014. The digital version of the indie PC hit published by GameMill Entertainment on the Xbox Live online entertainment network will include a split-screen for intense local hot-seat multiplayer, an all-new levelling system, high-resolution models, and exclusive maps.

Download the all new Xbox Live [I][B]Guncraft [/B][/I]screenshots and video [B][URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hightail.com%2Fdownload%2FZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw']HERE[/URL][/B]: [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hightail.com%2Fdownload%2FZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw']www.hightail.com/download/ZUczZm1aTlFVbStKUmNUQw[/URL]

Check out the new [B][I]Guncraft[/I][/B] video on YouTube [B][URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DpNTjEYm-O40']HERE[/URL]:[/B] [URL='http://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=25254777&msgid=507205&act=60VM&c=275324&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DpNTjEYm-O40']www.youtube.com/watch?v=pNTjEYm-O40[/URL]

“The response we have received for [B][I]Guncraft[/I][/B] from the PC community has been nothing short of fantastic, so we’re thrilled to reach even more players by bringing the game to the Xbox 360 platform,” said John Getty, Lead Developer of [B][I]Guncraft[/I][/B] and founder of Exato Game Studios. "[I][B]Guncraft [/B][/I]is the perfect blend of sandbox gameplay, crafting, and intense FPS action.”

Marrying the addictive nature of block building sandbox games with the speed and competition of modern first-person shooters, [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] takes voxel-based gaming to a whole new level. Play through dozens of maps, then create your own level with secret tunnels and hiding holes to find the best look out for ambushing your friends.  Players can create arenas based on anything imaginable, and once complete, utterly destroy them with bullets, bombs, grenades, tanks, helicopters and even laser swords. In the heat of battle, soldiers can create custom blockades and fortresses instantaneously.

[I][B]GUNCRAFT [/B][/I][B]XBOX LIVE KEY FEATURES:[/B]

[LIST]
[*]Exclusive Xbox Live maps
[*]Includes all PC DLC
[*]Two-player split-screen local multiplayer
[*]Player-controlled vehicles, perks, killstreaks, class load-outs, clan system, and ranks
[*]Create custom levels, weapons and characters limited only by your imagination
[*]Outlandish game modes for up to 16 players, including:
[LIST]
[*]Lava Survival Mode - where magma slowly rises as players build upward to avoid the instant orange death. It’s a new variation of “Last Man Standing”
[*]Onslaught Mode - Where four players band together to fight off endless waves of deadly robot spiders, soldiers, drones, and aircraft
[*]Spleef Mode - Where players drill and destroy blocks on the platform near or under their opponents in order to cause them to fall to their deaths while fervently moving to avoid suffering the same fate.
[/LIST]
[*]Exclusive levelling system where you earn new rewards with every other level, all the way up to level 550 (50 levels per ReCraft rank - one base, 10 ReCrafted ranks)
[*]New high-resolution models with an unlockable aesthetics system containing 300 pieces of unique gear to customize characters.  Each are individually customizable, giving gamers over 4 billion different combinations
[*]New tutorial system for learning the basics of Guncraft and each game mode
[/LIST]

[I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] players have all of the standard multiplayer shooter modes such as Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch, plus tons of custom load-outs, perks, plenty of weapons, vehicles and more. Even better, the core crafting mechanics of [I][B]Guncraft[/B][/I] are available throughout every aspect of the game, enabling players to build maps, characters, and weapons on the fly and then decimate it all to take down enemies.

notes.title: THREE New Block Packs Released!
notes.content:

[list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/280030/]Wild West[/url] - Get ready gunslingers, your Wild West pack is here. Containing 54 new cowboy era blocks, you can create the most epic showdown of a map ever. Just be sure to create your own matching skin and gun to go with it!
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/280031/]Under the Sea[/url] - Create your perfect aquatic landscape with this premium block pack. Containing 45 brand new blocks and a new coral reef themed skybox, you can develop your own underwater paradise full of life and color.
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/280032/]Deep Cave[/url] - Get ready to spelunk in this premium deep cave block pack. Create the perfect cavern with 56 new blocks.
[/list]

Can't wait to see what you guys come up with!!

Block and Load!

notes.title: Version 1.77 Release Notes
notes.content:
1.77 Crashes, tweaks and ready for rebalance

[[Included in steam 1.76 patch but new for non steam people]]
* Fixed startup crashes when workshop files you are subscribed to are missing
* Fixed stencil file crash if you are in spanish language
* Light block outlines in gunsmithing now appear
* Full Screen mouse now works 100% of the time after you enter settings screen

[[New for 1.77]]
* NEW MAP: 2Fort from TF2 (yes with full permission)
* Officially licensed TF2 weapons to go with the TF2 skins
http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198108762115/myworkshopfiles/?section=collections&appid=241720
* Visual recoil - and its an option choice on custom guns DEFAULT=OFF
* Craftys in firing range now hold your gun and show the 4 main animations
(So you can see how stupid it looks when your truck gun 'reloads')
* Size of cursor and offset included in foundry
* New font
* Updates to enable gun rebalance
* Elevator blocks are not destroyable
* Several startup and other crashes.

notes.title: 1.75 Live - Getting READY for workshop
notes.content:
1.75 - Getting READY for workshop
* Added new level - Sandy Springs
* Internal updates that mean steam workshop beta (soon.....) wont crash non beta people when they play with them
* Added proper gun lighting - they wont look as flat any more
* Updated TwitchTV SDK - no functional changes but fixes some internal Twitch issues
* More gun rebalancing - when workshop releases old guns will be forced to update
* Added dummy player to shoot at in firing range
* Added load/save of color palletes in gunsmithing
* Added RGB values for colors in gunsmithing
* Fixed blurry ironsights in CTF (about time too... this bug has been lurking a long time - nice job Kelby)
* Fixed 0 radius explosions not doing any damage to players or vehicles
* Fixed random hit markers appearing when vehicles are destroyed
* Removed Smoke from muzzle flash
* Bouncing Bettys no longer explode on impact with person, Frag Grenades do.
* Vehicles don't activate your own bouncing bettys
* Moving backwards no longer shows melee animation with your gun
* Modified some editor keys to use modifiers to prevent accidental usage - see controls document
* Thicker and more contrasting block outlines in gunsmithing
* Improved crash logging on standalone servers
* Fixed proxy issue where some ISPs dont let users call our backend (Just for you Lucho!)
* .... and probably several other bugs and issues too small to list here.

notes.title: Build 1.74
notes.content:
Now live on Steam and Exato.

KNOWN ISSUES:
* Seems the complexity indicator is not as accurate as I hoped. Its actually an estimate because actually counting every time is too slow. The estimate is too low. Some 99% guns will still fail to render. So anything over 98% is at your own risk!

1.74 - Crash fixes.

1.73 - Finally some standalone server changes (and more)
* Added saving, auto restart and command like startup to standalone server
* Spawn protection now cancels as soon as you shoot
* Improved startup time after pressing continue 
* Added gun complexity indicator to show if a gun will render properly - sorry its not a fix but at least you will know now (See known issues)
* Fixed some steam achievement unlocks - "do X without dying"
* Can't kick people from ranked matches
* Can't be killed by vehicles in free build
* world doesn't wrap vertically in freebuild
* Mouse buttons 4 and 5 can be used in controls editor
* More crash fixes from your reports - keep sending them in!
